sourceNotes.rawContent: Celebrate romance with this chic "Love" heart bracelet. Adorned with shimmering crystals, this high-fashion piece adds a sentimental glow to any look. To maintain its radiant golden luster, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it safely in a dry place after every wear.
